title: The v1 autoimmune, HIV, and allergy examples are unsourced
summary: Lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, type 1 diabetes, HIV, and IgE allergies were named without a source we opened.
body: The v1 immune article lists autoimmune diseases (lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, type 1 diabetes), immunodeficiency including HIV/AIDS, and allergies as IgE-mediated. Those are standard clinical topics. This pass did not open a page that stated each example. Leave the list unsourced rather than lending it a fake citation. The innate/adaptive distinction and the WHO vaccination description are sourced on other cards.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
